violation_type.title: Required Admission Information - Prescribed Medications; Long Term Use (26 TAC §746.605(12)(C))
violation_type.short_title: Required Admission Information - Prescribed Medications; Long Term Use
violation_type.typical_finding: Two children did not have medication at the operation for a prescribed allergy or medical condition as indicated that was needed for the child's condition by a medical professional on their FARE forms.

finding_variants.text: Two children did not have medication at the operation for a prescribed allergy or medical condition as indicated that was needed for the child's condition by a medical professional on their FARE forms.
The operation did not have required  medication listed on Food Emergency plan.
During the inspection the operation did not have a medication listed on a Food Emergency Plan.

Based on the investigation findings, this standard was reviewed and found to be in non-compliance with The Minimum Standards for Child Care Centers. Prior to the child attending on 03/11/2026, the operation did not have the child's epi-pen on file for the child's allergy.
